subject: Campus Drive: Northwind Analytics - Registration open
body:
Dear students,

Northwind Analytics will visit campus to hire Software Engineers from the 2027 batch. Eligibility: CGPA 7.0 and above, no active backlogs. CTC: 14 LPA.

Register on the placement portal by 23 October 2026, 5:00 PM. The online test will be held on 28 October, and shortlisted students will be interviewed on campus on 3 November.

Regards,
Training & Placement Cell

Placement Office

Please confirm your participation by replying to this email by tomorrow.

body:
Dear students,

This is a reminder of the placement policy: once you accept an offer through the placement cell, you will not be allowed to sit for further campus drives, except dream companies with a CTC above 20 LPA. Students who skip a drive after registering will be barred from the next two drives.

Regards,
Training & Placement Cell
